_doc: Benchmark cases per writing language (general writing, 10 each), added to the suite for the languages a user writes in (ghostd's `languages` setting; run.py --styles --languages). Keys: a language code, matched to the user's languages by language (pt serves pt-BR and pt-PT, es every Spanish variant); zh-Hans and zh-Hant by script. English is the rest of the suite. Each case: text typed so far (some stop mid-word), rest = what was typed next. No case may share text with a prompt example (bench/check_cases.py).
